constraints: Upgrade one Alpine branch at a time and reinstall packages from the target repositories.
Confirm services and pinned packages have builds for the target branch.

steps.instructions: Move the host to a supported Alpine branch with the documented upgrade procedure, or rebuild it and redeploy the workload.
steps.title: Upgrade the Alpine host

verification.purpose: Confirm the host reports the target Alpine branch.
Check that the target repositories are reachable and current.

rules.summary: Alpine Linux 3.20, the newest release this range covers, stopped receiving security updates on 2026-04-01; older release branches ended earlier. Each branch is supported for about two years.
rules.title: Alpine Linux 3.20 and older are end-of-life
